categories.help: Farm spaces left empty, each costing one point.

categories.help: Points printed on your played improvements and occupations.

categories.help: Begging cards taken, each costing three points.

categories.label: Building resources left
categories.help: Leftover wood, clay, reed and stone; the most wins a tie.

notes: Seven animal and crop categories score from tables on the board, so they are entered as the table result. Category list recalled from the publisher rulebook and not yet re-checked against the printed copy (see source.checked_against_rulebook).
